## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Tooth and Smile Dental Clinic?
60/71, Appu Street, Mylapore, Chennai 600 004.

### What facilities does Tooth and Smile Dental Clinic have?
Dental implants, All-on-4 implants, Aligners / Invisalign, Invisible braces, Smile alignment, Crowns & bridges, Root canal treatment, Tooth-coloured fillings, Dentures, Extraction & wisdom tooth removal, Gum treatment, Pediatric dentistry, Geriatric dentistry, Dental tourism.

### What is all-on-4?
A technique that supports a full arch of teeth on four implants, simplifying implant therapy and reducing healing and procedure time.

### Do you treat children and older adults?
Yes — we offer pediatric dentistry for children and geriatric dentistry for older adults.
